verdict.rationale: Intel's marketing repeatedly stresses speed and 'fastest desktop gaming processors' but independent reviews (Tom's Hardware, HN discussion) show the 285K actually regresses in gaming and lags AMD's 9950X in raw single-thread/perf-per-watt, plus reports of Windows-specific single-threaded performance problems and memory-related instability. This directly contradicts a claim of leading single-thread interactive performance in independent benchmarks. missing for 10: dedicated single-thread benchmark citation (e.g., Cinebench ST) showing category leadership, resolution of Windows scheduling issues, and consistent cross-review consensus.
